description: This Java class 'CmpMerge' provides a command-line tool to merge multiple component mapping files (.cmp files) used in PCB design, specifically for KiCad. It reads multiple source files, extracts relevant lines, and writes a combined output file with a header and footer.

classes.name: CmpMerge
classes.description: Main class providing static methods to merge '.cmp' files via command line.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that processes command-line arguments, reads multiple source files, and writes the merged output.

methods.name: readFileToList
methods.description: Reads a file into a list of strings, skipping headers and footers.

methods.name: checkExistence
methods.description: Checks if the given file exists; terminates program if not.
